item.title: नेपालमा बाढीपहिरोको कहर: २१ जनाको मृत्यु, सयौँ परिवार विस्थापित
item.description: संक्षिप्त सारांश: नेपालका विभिन्न जिल्लामा अविरल वर्षापछि आएको बाढीपहिरोमा परी कम्तीमा २१ जनाको मृत्यु, पाँच जना बेपत्ता र पाँच जना घाइते भएका छन्। हजारौँलाई सुरक्षित स्थानमा सारिएको छ भने बाढीले बस्ती, सडक र घरहरूमा ठूलो क्षति पुर्‍याएको छ।

item.title: Welcome to the new home of CityVision TV
item.description: News, shows and stories from the Nepali community in Australia, now in one place. Here is what you will find and how to stay in the loop.

item.title: Holding a community event? Send it to us to be listed
item.description: Share your event with the community. Send us the name, date, time, location and a short description.

item.title: Hamro Story: new episodes on the last Saturday of every month
item.description: Our series about Nepali people building their lives in Australia continues, with a new episode released on the last Saturday of each month.

item.title: Follow CityVision TV on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok
item.description: Find us wherever you watch, and turn on notifications so you never miss a new episode.

item.title: Kurakani: the podcast sharing stories of the Nepali diaspora
item.description: Long-form conversations with members of the Nepali community in Australia. Listen now on Spotify.
